descriptionChirho: Proper masculine name Achbor/Akhbor (עַכְבּוֹר, possibly meaning 'mouse'), borne by at least two individuals: the father of the Edomite king Baal-Hanan (Gen 36:38-39) and the father of Elnathan, a courtier of King Josiah sent to retrieve the prophetess Huldah (2 Kgs 22:12). Multilingual glosses uniformly transliterate: eng 'Akhbor / and-Akhbor', spa 'Akbor / y-Acbor', arb 'عَكْبور / و-عَكْبور', kor '악보르 / 그리고-악볼', swa 'Akbori / na-Akbori'. The clusters differ only by the conjunction waw prefix.
